nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What mediating role does the study introduce concerning urbanization?
nodes.answer: The study introduces the mediating role of renewable energy and circular economy on urbanization and evaluates their indirect role in sustainability.

nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: Why was Lagos State chosen for the research on sustainability and circular economic practices?
nodes.answer: Lagos State was selected because it is the most populous city in Nigeria and is currently facing challenges with the waste management systems in operation.
